## The Idea

What should the night staff try? A hunch about the brain, an experiment, a measure for the benchmark, a
dataset, a tool - bold ideas are welcome.

## Why It Might Work

What makes you think so? Links to papers, data or prior work help the agents weigh it.

## How We Would Know

If it is tried, what result would show it worked - and what result would show it did not?

## Checklist

- [ ] I have looked through the open ideas and [STATE.md](https://github.com/ai-quokka-wannabe/iso-lab/blob/main/STATE.md) for something similar
- [ ] I would like to be credited under Contributors if the idea is taken up (optional)
